name: com.rtlpdf/arabic-pdf
title: RTL PDF
description: Correctly shaped right-to-left PDFs for Arabic, Urdu and Persian text.

tools.name: make_pdf_arabic
tools.description: Create a PDF from Arabic, Urdu or Persian text, or text that mixes them with English, with every letter correctly joined, lines running right to left, and numbers, dates, phone numbers and Latin words kept in order. Suited to PDFs, printable files, letters, notices, invoices, certificates, menus and handouts in Arabic, Urdu or Persian. The text is printed exactly as given; light Markdown is supported: '# ' headings, blank lines between paragraphs, '- ' bullets, '1. ' numbered lists, '| a | b |' tables (a '|---|' row marks a header) and **bold**. Returns a download link that works for 24 hours. It only lays out text: it does not write, translate or change wording, and it does not make images.

text.description: The full text to print, in Arabic, Urdu or Persian (English may be mixed in). Light Markdown allowed.
text.title: Text

language.description: Language of the text. 'auto' detects Urdu and Persian letters.
language.title: Language

font.description: 'auto' picks Nastaliq for Urdu and Naskh otherwise. Cairo and Tajawal are modern sans styles.
font.title: Font

font_size.description: Text size in points, 7 to 28. Leave empty for the font's default.
font_size.title: Font Size

title.description: Document title for the PDF metadata and file name. Defaults to the first heading.
title.title: Title

page_numbers.description: Print page numbers when there is more than one page.
page_numbers.title: Page Numbers

bleed.description: Add 3 mm bleed and crop marks for professional printing.
bleed.title: Bleed

archival.description: Export as PDF/A-2a with PDF/UA-1 (archival and accessible), falling back to PDF/A-2b.
archival.title: Archival

tools.name: check_arabic_text
tools.description: Check Arabic, Urdu or Persian text for problems that break PDFs, search and copy-paste: pre-shaped glyph characters and reversed letter order (typical of text copied out of a broken PDF), Persian or Urdu letters mixed into Arabic and the reverse, hidden direction-control characters, mixed digit systems, and characters the fonts cannot print. Returns the issues in English and Arabic and, when a safe fix exists, a fixed version of the text for the user to review. Deterministic rules; no AI.
